item.title: Bucky Irving: Could have workload managed in second half
item.description:
Head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that the Buccaneers "will try and lessen the load" on Irving following their Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

item.title: Jonathon Brooks: Awaits update on status ahead of Week 10
item.description:
Coach Dave Canales said Monday that the Panthers will spend the next two days discussing the status of Brooks (core), Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Xavier Worthy: Considered day-to-day, per Reid
item.description:
Coach Andy Reid said Monday that Worthy (hamstring) is considered day-to-day in advance of Sunday's game against the Falcons, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

item.title: Patrick Mahomes: Deemed day-to-day by Reid
item.description:
Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Monday that Mahomes (elbow) is considered day-to-day as this Sunday's game against the Falcons approaches, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Drew Lock: Encouraging results regarding oblique injury
item.description:
Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Lock's tests on his oblique injury were "good," and the issue is something the QB is expected to manage ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.
